C143752.name: Peripheral Sensory Neuropathy, CTCAE
C143752.definition: A disorder characterized by damage or dysfunction of the peripheral sensory nerves.

C144912.name: Grade 2 Peripheral Sensory Neuropathy, CTCAE
C144912.definition: Moderate symptoms; limiting instrumental ADL or mild/moderate impact on age-appropriate normal daily activity (pediatric)

C145535.name: Grade 3 Peripheral Sensory Neuropathy, CTCAE
C145535.definition: Severe symptoms; limiting self-care ADL or severe impact on age-appropriate normal daily activity (pediatric)
